build_meter_provider: build a MeterProvider that sends OpenTelemetry metrics to an OTLP collector via gRPC or HTTP
setup_metrics: setup OTel metrics middleware on a FastAPI app to track HTTP request counters and durations
create_http_request_counter: create a counter instrument to track total HTTP server requests with method, route, and status code attributes
create_duration_histogram: create a histogram instrument to measure HTTP request duration in milliseconds
create_user_gauges: create observable gauges to report total registered users, active users, and users active today
